name: China Great Wall Securities Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Great Wall Securities Co.,Ltd. engages in the securities brokerage business in China. It operates through five segments: Wealth Management Business, Investment Banking Operations, Asset Management Business, Securities Investment and Trading Business, and Others. The company offers wealth management services, such as securities brokerage, financial product sales, futures brokerage, margin trading, repurchase agreements and stock-pledged repurchase, investment consulting, and other services. It also provides investment banking services, including equity financing, debt financing, and financial advisory services; asset management services; investment and trading of fixed-income securities…
